facts.text: Michael O’Steen is the Managing Director at The PARC Group.
The PARC Group is Nocatee’s master developer.
The Chophouse at Nocatee is owned and managed by the same team behind Chophouse Thirteen in Mandarin.
Riley Skinner is the Vice President of Skinner Brothers Realty.
The retail expansion is 17,000 square feet.
The retail expansion is anchored by a high-end steakhouse called Chophouse Nocatee.
Chophouse Nocatee has a rooftop bar.
The expansion is part of Nocatee’s Town Center.
The Town Center is described as walkable.
The walkable Town Center has been worked on over the past several years.
